subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia successfully stabilized after the battle, rolling a 16 on her death save.
source_quote: Zinnia successfully stabilized, rolling a 16 on her save, securing her survival.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer struck the killing blow against Rannos for the second time this session using his Spiritual Weapon.
source_quote: It was Calmer who, for the second time this session, struck the killing blow using his Spiritual Weapon, dispatching Rannos (who was down to 2 hit points) with a dramatic flourish.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer cast Cure Light Wounds on Zinnia, healing her for 24 points.
source_quote: Calmer then rushed to Zinnia and cast Cure Light Wounds, healing her for 24 points.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne revealed his 'cleaning' skills and offered his services to the party on a retainer basis (20 gold pieces per month plus 100 gold pieces per incident).
source_quote: Thorne revealed his 'cleaning' skills and offered his services to the party on a retainer basis (20 gold pieces per month plus 100 gold pieces per incident).

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne confirmed his cynical, money-driven nature and his lack of loyalty to the cult.
source_quote: Thorne confirmed his cynical, money-driven nature and his lack of loyalty to the cult.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne instructed Zinnia and Calmer to take the victims' bloodied clothes and ride out of town to abandon them, simulating a struggle.
source_quote: Thorne executed his cleanup, then instructed Zinnia and Calmer to take the victims' bloodied clothes and ride out of town to abandon them, simulating a struggle.

subject: Thorne
fact: Thorne told Zephyr and Sequoia to return to the Inn of the Welcome Wench and spread the story that Rannos and Gremag had urgently left town after securing a magical chest.
source_quote: Zephyr and Sequoia were told to return to the Inn of the Welcome Wench and spread the story that Rannos and Gremag had urgently left town after securing a magical chest.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia's high Insight roll (a natural 20) confirmed that Elmo was feigning inebriation and working for Verbobonc.
source_quote: Zinnia's high Insight roll (a natural 20) confirmed the party's suspicions: Elmo was feigning inebriation and working for Verbobonc.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo immediately dropped the act after Zephyr decided to expose his subterfuge, agreeing to speak with the party as equals in a private room.
source_quote: Elmo immediately dropped the act, agreeing to speak with the party as equals in a private room.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo confirmed he was an agent for Verbobonc and was dismayed that the chest had supposedly left with Rannos and Gremag.
source_quote: Elmo confirmed he was an agent for Verbobonc and was dismayed that the chest had supposedly left with Rannos and Gremag.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo gave the party an urgent task: return to the Moathouse immediately to 'investigate what's going on and destroy whatever evil presence is there'.
source_quote: He emphasized the political sensitivity—Verbobonc could not send troops without risking conflict with the gnomes of the Kron Hills.

subject: Elmo's mission
fact: Elmo's urgent task to investigate the Moathouse and destroy the evil presence there remains unresolved, with no confirmation of success or failure in this session.
source_quote: He gave the party an urgent task: return to the Moathouse immediately to 'investigate what's going on and destroy whatever evil presence is there'

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia's stoic presence reassured Calmer despite his inward shaking from the bloodshed.
source_quote: Calmer, despite being inwardly shaken by the bloodshed, was reassured by Zinnia’s stoic presence.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr escalated the situation by mocking Lareth: 'The only person here that's backstabbing is you.'
source_quote: Zephyr escalated the situation further by mocking him: 'The only person here that's backstabbing is you.'

subject: Lareth
fact: Lareth saw through the party's deception despite their successful persuasion check, furious that they had failed his mission and were attempting to backstab him.
source_quote: Lareth rolled a high check and saw through their deception, furious that they had failed his mission and were now attempting to backstab him.

subject: Lareth
fact: Lareth accused the party of treachery and triggered a call to arms, initiating combat.
source_quote: He accused them of treachery. Lareth's reaction was immediate and decisive, triggering a call to arms and initiating combat.

subject: Burne and Rufus
fact: Burne and Rufus confirmed Elmo had sent the rangers after the missing chest and urged the party to deal with the Moathouse.
source_quote: Burne and Rufus approached the party, confirming Elmo (now referred to simply as 'Elmo') had sent the rangers after the missing chest. They, too, urged the party to deal with the Moathouse.

subject: The party
fact: The party killed two gnoll guards at the secret entrance and delivered the severed heads to Lareth's guard as a dramatic flourish.
source_quote: They killed two gnoll guards at the secret entrance with ease, and then delivered the dramatic flourish of the severed heads to Lareth's guard.

subject: Lareth
fact: Lareth greeted the party with predatory suspicion, having heard rumors of the deaths in the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Lareth greeted them with predatory suspicion, having heard rumors of the deaths in the Earth Temple.

subject: The party
fact: The party attempted to lie to Lareth, claiming the Deep Temple had taken the chest and that Rannos and Gremag were acting on Lareth's behalf.
source_quote: The party attempted to lie, claiming the Deep Temple had taken the chest and that Rannos and Gremag were acting on Lareth's behalf.

subject: The chest's whereabouts
fact: The true location of the magical chest remains unknown and unresolved in this session, with conflicting reports from Thorne, Elmo, and the party.
source_quote: Elmo was dismayed that the chest had supposedly left with Rannos and Gremag.

subject: Verbobonc's political constraints
fact: Verbobonc's inability to send troops without risking conflict with the gnomes of the Kron Hills remains an unresolved strategic constraint.
source_quote: He emphasized the political sensitivity—Verbobonc could not send troops without risking conflict with the gnomes of the Kron Hills.

subject: Ostler Goodingoat
fact: Ostler Goodingoat questioned the party about the sudden departure of the merchants, and they successfully bluffed him with the story of the magical chest leaving town.
source_quote: The tavern keeper, Ostler Goodingoat, questioned the party about the sudden departure of the merchants, and they successfully bluffed him with the story of the magical chest leaving town.

subject: Elmo
fact: Elmo rushed off to contact the rangers to pursue the missing chest.
source_quote: He rushed off to contact the rangers to pursue the missing chest.

subject: The party
fact: The party decided to go directly to Lareth the Beautiful's headquarters to confront him.
source_quote: The party decided to go directly to Lareth the Beautiful's headquarters to confront him.

subject: The party
fact: The session concluded just as the fight with Lareth and his guards was about to begin.
source_quote: The session concluded just as the fight with Lareth and his guards was about to begin.
